params.description: Specifies whether existing parts are overwritten or only new ones added (optional). 0: Append only new ones (default value). 1: Overwrite existing. 2: Overwrite existing and append new. This parameter is only effective with the following value of the TYPE parameter: "SYSTEMPARTSTOPROJECT".

translate.name: translate
translate.description: Action class for translate functions: translate a project, export missing translation list, and remove languages from a project.

params.name: TYPE
params.description: Type of task to be performed by the action: - "TRANSLATEPROJECT": Translate project - "TRANSLATEPAGES": Translate given pages - "REMOVELANGUAGE": Remove language entry - "EXPORTMISSINGTRANSLATIONS": Export missing-word list - "IMPORTTOTRANSDB": Import database texts - "EXPORTFROMTRANSDB": Export database texts - "CORRECT": Corrects translations

params.name: PROJECTNAME
params.description: Project name with full path (optional). If not entered, the selected project is used when the action is called from GUI (like from a script or ribbon bar). If called from the windows command line, the PROJECTNAME must be set or the ProjectAction (see also "XEsProjectAction") must be used first, otherwise an exception is thrown (see also "System.ArgumentException").

params.name: IMPORTFILE
params.description: Name of the file with texts to import. Only applies to the parameter TYPE equal to "IMPORTTOTRANSDB"

params.name: EXPORTFILE
params.description: Name of file containing exported missing word list. This parameter is only effective with the TYPE equal to "EXPORTMISSINGTRANSLATIONS" or "EXPORTFROMTRANSDB"

params.name: CONVERTER
params.description: Name of converter (optional). This name is used as the input and output format. Default values:"XTrLanguageDbXmlConverterImpl" (Native format XML) for TYPE equal to "EXPORTFROMTRANSDB", XTrLanguageDbXml2TabConverterImpl for "IMPORTTOTRANSDB" and "EXPORTMISSINGTRANSLATIONS" This parameter is only effective with the TYPE equal to "EXPORTMISSINGTRANSLATIONS", "IMPORTTOTRANSDB" or "EXPORTFROMTRANSDB"

params.name: LANGUAGE
params.description: Translation language, e.g., "fr_FR"

params.name: USEPAGEFILTER
params.description: Determines if only filtered pages should be used or all project pages (optional). It corresponds to "Active" check box in GUI. These parameters are only effective with the "TRANSLATEPAGES" value of the TYPE parameter. Default value: 0

params.name: PAGFILTERNAME
params.description: Pages are read from pagefilter with the name pagefiltername.These parameters are only effective with the "TRANSLATEPAGES" value of the TYPE parameter.

params.name: PAGENAME
params.description: Name of the page to be translated (optional).

params.name: PAGENAMEn
params.description: Names of the pages to be translated (optional), where n is a number e.g. /PAGENAME1:=AP+ST1/2 /PAGENAME2:=AP+ST1/4 /PAGENAME3:=AP+ST1/7 etc. These parameters are only effective with the "TRANSLATEPAGES" value of the TYPE parameter.

params.name: SELn
params.description: Identifier of the pages to be translated (optional), where n is a number (e.g. /SEL1:38/4/12/0 (result from StorableObject.ToStringIdentifier())) parameters are only effective with the "TRANSLATEPAGES" value of the TYPE parameter.

params.name: CONVERTTRANSLATEDTEXTS
params.description: Determines if already translated texts should be also converted. Default value: 0. This parameter is only effective with the TYPE equal to "CORRECT".
